integrity: A proof classifies all possible empty pair families as star subfamilies or full triangles; exact local inclusion-exclusion yields the polynomial, and unique-center star counting yields the minimum count. A direct four-label enumeration for n=5 and direct star-support enumeration through n=7 agree with the separately written polynomial implementation.
scientific_limitations: The exact all-weight inclusion-exclusion theorem and optimizer classification apply to two-subset Kneser graphs for every integer n>=5. They do not apply to higher-subset Kneser graphs or assert a compact product formula. Unindexed equivalent results remain a historical-priority risk, and mathematical checks are not independent validation.
title: Outer-independent two-rainbow polynomials and optimum colorings of \(\operatorname{KG}(n,2)\)
